questions.question: Which type of label is the most numerous in atoms with hydrogen?
questions.evidence: with hydrogen refers to fld003 = 'h'; label most numerous in atoms refers to MAX(COUNT(fld007));
questions.SQL: SELECT T.fld007 FROM (SELECT T2.fld007, COUNT(T2.fld002) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld003 = 'h' GROUP BY T2.fld007 ORDER BY COUNT(T2.fld002) DESC LIMIT 1) AS t
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T.label FROM ( SELECT T2.label, COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.element = 'h' GROUP BY T2.label ORDER BY COUNT(T2.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) t

questions.question: What is the percentage of element chlorine in carcinogenic molecules?
questions.evidence: chlorine refers to fld003 = 'cl'; fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'pb'); COUNT(fld002)) as percentage where fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.fld003 = 'cl' THEN T1.fld003 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld003) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT( CASE WHEN T1.element = 'cl' THEN T1.element ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.element) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

questions.question: What is the most common bond type?
questions.evidence: most common bond type refers MAX(COUNT(fld005))
questions.SQL: SELECT T.fld005 FROM (SELECT fld005, COUNT(fld004) FROM tab02 GROUP BY fld005 ORDER BY COUNT(fld004) DESC LIMIT 1) AS T
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

questions.question: Which element is the least numerous in non-carcinogenic molecules?
questions.evidence: fld007 = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic; least numerous refers to MIN(COUNT(fld003));
questions.SQL: SELECT T.fld003 FROM (SELECT T1.fld003, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld002) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld007 = '-' GROUP BY T1.fld003 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld002) ASC LIMIT 1) AS t
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T.element FROM (SELECT T1.element, COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.element ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id) ASC LIMIT 1) t

questions.question: How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?
questions.evidence: with iodine element refer to fld003 = 'i'; with sulfur element refers to fld003 = 's'; single type bond refers to fld005 = '-'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.fld003 = 'i' THEN T1.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.fld003 = 's' THEN T1.fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T3 ON T2.fld004 = T3.fld004 WHERE T3.fld005 = '-'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

questions.question: What proportion of single bonds are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with five decimal places.
questions.evidence: single bond refers to fld005 = '-'; fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; proportion = DIVIDE(SUM(fld007 = '+') * 100, COUNT(fld004)) where fld005 = '-'
questions.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.fld007 = '+' THEN T1.fld004 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld004), 5) FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld005 = '-'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id),5) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'

questions.question: What is the average number of bonds the atoms with the element iodine have?
questions.evidence: atoms with the element iodine refers to fld003 = 'i'; average = DIVIDE(COUND(fld004), COUNT(fld001)) where fld003 = 'i'
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.fld004) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld003 = 'i'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'i'

questions.question: What are the bond type and the atoms of the bond ID of TR001_6_9?
questions.evidence: atoms refer to fld001 or fld006
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld005, T2.fld001, T2.fld006 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 WHERE T2.fld004 = 'TR001_6_9'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.bond_type, T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.bond_id = T2.bond_id WHERE T2.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

questions.question: What is the ratio of Hydrogen elements in molecule ID TR006? List the ratio with its label.
questions.evidence: hydrogen refers to fld003 = 'h'; ratio = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'h'), count(fld003)) where fld002 = 'TR006' ; fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; fld007 = '-' means molecules are non-carcinogenic
questions.SQL: WITH SubQuery AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld001, T1.fld003, T1.fld002, T2.fld007 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld002 = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN fld003 = 'h' THEN fld001 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (CASE WHEN COUNT(fld001) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(fld001) END) AS ratio, fld007 FROM SubQuery GROUP BY fld007
questions.SQL_original: WITH SubQuery AS (SELECT DISTINCT T1.atom_id, T1.element, T1.molecule_id, T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.molecule_id = 'TR006') SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN element = 'h' THEN atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) / (CASE WHEN COUNT(atom_id) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(atom_id) END) AS ratio, label FROM SubQuery GROUP BY label

questions.question: Please list top three molecules that have single bonds between two atoms and are not carcinogenic in alphabetical order.
questions.evidence: fld007 = '-' means molecules are not carcinogenic; single type bond refers to fld005 = '-'; list top three molecules refers to return fld002 and order by fld002;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.fld002 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T1.fld005 = '-' AND T2.fld007 = '-' ORDER BY T2.fld002 LIMIT 3
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T2.label = '-' ORDER BY T2.molecule_id LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the percentage of molecules that are carcinogenic? Please provide your answer as a percentage with three decimal places.
questions.evidence: fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld007 = '+'), COUNT(fld002)) as percent
questions.SQL: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.fld007 = '+' THEN T.fld002 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.fld002), 3) FROM tab04 AS t
questions.SQL_original: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T.label = '+' THEN T.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T.molecule_id),3) FROM molecule t

questions.question: Calculate the total atoms with triple-bond molecules containing the element phosphorus or bromine.
questions.evidence: triple bond refers to fld005 = '#'; phosphorus refers to fld003 = 'p'; bromine refers to fld003 = 'br'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T3 ON T2.fld002 = T3.fld002 WHERE T3.fld005 = '#' AND T1.fld003 IN ('p', 'br')
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T1.element IN ('p', 'br')

questions.question: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
questions.evidence: fld007 = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; contain fluorine refers to fld003 = 'f'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(fld003 = 'f') * 100, COUNT(fld002)) where fld007 = '+'; Should consider the distinct atoms when counting;
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.fld003 <> 'f' THEN T2.fld002 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.fld002) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T1.fld002 = T2.fld002 WHERE T2.fld007 = '+'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

questions.question: What are the bonds that have phosphorus and nitrogen as their atom elements?

questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld004 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T2.fld004 IN (SELECT T3.fld004 FROM tab03 AS T3 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T4 ON T3.fld001 = T4.fld001 WHERE T4.fld003 = 'p') AND T1.fld003 = 'n'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.bond_id FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_id IN ( SELECT T3.bond_id FROM connected AS T3 INNER JOIN atom AS T4 ON T3.atom_id = T4.atom_id WHERE T4.element = 'p' ) AND T1.element = 'n'
